method.check.bad: {another} = « (you can choose another one)» or empty.
method.source.pick: Line above the source table when there are several methods; {select} = drop-down menu (HTML).
method.pda.value: PDA detector line; {start}, {stop}, {step} = wavelengths in nm.
method.error: Error in the method window; {message} = technical text.
method.row.ms2n: «MS2» row of the parameters table; {n} = number of scans, {per} = per cycle.
method.name: Name of a method inside a .dam file that contains more than one (one per sample); {n} = number.
method.m.title: Title of the section of an Agilent method folder (.m) in the Method window; {name} = folder name.
method.m.windows: Line under the compounds table of a .m method: method windows; {ref} = reference RT window, {non} = of the others, {unit} = unit (%), {corr} = correlation window.
method.doc.fields: Title of the collapsible box with all the fields of the file, in the Method window; {n} = how many.
method.doc.btn.xic.tip: Title and aria-label of the «XIC» button of an inclusion-list row in the Method window; {mz} = m/z of the entry.
method.doc.btn.ms2.tip: Title and aria-label of the «MS2» button of an inclusion-list row, when an MS² scan matches; {mz} = precursor m/z, {rt} = RT of the scan in minutes.
method.doc.solvent: Label of the row of an LC pump solvent in the recorded method; {ch} = channel (A, B...).
method.m.error: Error reading a .m method in the Method window; {name} = folder, {message} = reason.
method.reg.go: Accessible name of the button of an error-log entry in the method window: moves the cursor to its time; {t} = time in minutes.
method.doc.notes: Title of the list, at the top of the method section in the Method window, of the method/1.warnings entries (parts not decoded, missing, truncated).
